A small arcade,
built for class.

Familiar games, simple rules, and a little time to think.

Pocket Arcade brings seven games together in one place. Flip a light, test a code, or move a tile: each board responds as you play.

Seven ways to play

Minesweeper and Lights Out are board puzzles. Memory Match tests your recall, Code Guess is a colour-code challenge, and Number Slide is a sliding tile puzzle. Connect the Dots tests your memory with three dot patterns, while Tic-tac-toe is for two people sharing one screen.

What happens to my scores?

Memory Match keeps your best round while its page stays open. Tic-tac-toe counts wins and draws during a match. Leaving or reloading clears this progress. Finished rounds save automatically in this browser. The score sheet shows them, accepts your own entries and can be printed. The home page shows your game records, with separate X wins, O wins and draws for Tic-tac-toe.

Built for the Web Programming course

The site uses HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no libraries or frameworks. The games use variables, conditions, loops, and browser-native controls. Small functions, click handlers and page updates let the games respond directly on the page; these additions are explained separately in the project report.
